encoding.judgments: Independent named fields impact, applicability, recommendation, validation; supported/partial/missing/incorrect.
encoding.quotes: Named quote-list fields contain exact short substrings of the evaluated report, not reasoning blocks or audit prose.
encoding.reasons: Named nullable reasons. Every nonsupported judgment has a reason.
encoding.actionable: All of impact, applicability and recommendation supported; validation counted separately. No weighted score.
encoding.raw: Only a completed substantive designated-planner report with observed native return or native audit attribution qualifies. Launch acknowledgments, waiting notes and parent fallback/implementation reports do not. Authored self-analysis labels cannot override agentType; parent claims alone cannot establish a missing native handback. A report assessment_ref resolves to independently checked family judgments when the selected quotes and judgments are identical across raw and final; boundaries and hashes remain independent.
encoding.final: Family assessment of the substantive delivered parent report. Null for absent/pending report. Returned_reports independently identifies its provenance and refers to this same assessment, avoiding duplicate evidence.
encoding.report_preservation: Original immutable message locators retain the complete authored report, including introductions, evidence claims, open questions and reviewer notes. No authored text is elided in defining the evaluated boundary. Only harness envelope, exactly two harness indentation spaces and trailing agentId/usage would be excluded from native report comparison. No original full private export is republished.
encoding.timing: Observed wall_time_ms = first natural request createdAt to frozen lastKnownAgentState idle updatedAt. Successful_plan_wall_time_ms requires an attributed designated report delivered without visible working-app edits. Native completion latency is separate from parent delivery latency; both start at the original request. Audit collection times do not extend scored-turn timing.
encoding.validation: Full support requires the entire scenario/control family. Global green suites alone do not specify a family test. Missing report validation is not a claim that no tests ran; observed partial tests are retained separately.
